text.p: Grossman's Inc said on Thursday it has named TM Capital Corp as its exclusive financial adviser.
The New York City firm is supposed to provide the company assistance in reviewing and implementing financial and strategic alternatives.

"While we are making progress in returning to operating profitability and divesting of our closed eastern real estate, it is imperative that we aggressively investigate all alternatives," Chairman and Chief Executive Robert Swanson said in a statement.

Grossman's Inc. operates 16 stores under the name Contractors' Warehouse in California, Indiana, Kentucky, Nevada and Ohio, and 24 stores under the name Mr. 2nd's Bargain Outlet in Massachusetts, New York and Rhode Island.
